title: Read published reviews from the Review repository

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: one targeted break check

Verdict: Caught.

Story: .planning/seeds/SEED-428-read-reviews-from-the-review-repository.md#read-reviews-from-the-review-repository (plan .planning/slice-plans/803-read-reviews-from-the-review-repository/PLAN.md)
Revision: f93980e4e90dd895b8ae588b70ef065aaeaafe23 (isolated detached scratch worktree; pre-probe `git status --porcelain` empty; `npm ci` run there).

Promise: "Keep attribution, comparison selection, Include merged changes, and every existing explanation of missing or uncertain evidence unchanged." Path: a Done story whose published history is shallow or unrecoverable is still explained as unavailable now that Done review reads the dashboard's Review repository (`kind: "unavailable"` with a history explanation and no files; in Intent, "No comparison is available." plus the historical-source-unavailable problem).

Fault: in dashboard/server/reviewRepository.ts, `syncedReviewRepository` ran `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` after `created(...)` and added `--unshallow` to the exact-ref fetch when true, so a shallow published history silently became complete at first sync. Fixtures and assertions unchanged (dashboard/test-support/support/reviewRepositoryFixture.ts `shallowPublishedHistory`, directly and via intentCompletedStory.ts `history: "shallow"`).

Independent witness: an esbuild bundle of the faulted module against a 3-commit local origin, a scratch HOME routing github.com/terryyin/open-dough to it, and a depth-1 bare Review repository. Faulted: before `shallow true commits 1`, after `syncedReviewRepository` `shallow false commits 3`. Restored: before and after `shallow true commits 1`.

Runs (strict default reporter; results from proof-record JSON):
- Baseline: backend 5/5 passed; e2e 4/4 passed, including both shallow-history tests.
- Faulted: 3 tests failed on the intended path:
  1. dashboard/backend-tests/review/story-review-completed-gaps.spec.ts:129 "missing claim history explains the gap rather than showing a partial comparison", caught at :145 `toMatchObject({ kind: "unavailable", explanation: stringMatching(/claim|history/) })`; received `kind: "published"`.
  2. e2e/intent/intent-done-retained-landing.spec.ts:49 "a Done story with a retained workspace explains its shallow published history", caught at :132; received `kind: "published"`.
  3. e2e/intent/intent-story-completed-source.spec.ts:88, caught at :104 `toHaveText("No comparison is available.")`; status stayed "Reading the story's changes…".
  The other 6 tests (complete-history and agent-recovery cases) passed.
- Restored (`git checkout -- dashboard/server/reviewRepository.ts`): backend 5/5 and e2e 4/4 passed; `git status --porcelain` empty, `git diff --quiet HEAD` clean, HEAD f93980e4e.

Scope: the Review-repository sync path for a shallow published trunk, through the API answer (backend and e2e) and the Intent view text. Not run: intent-done-prior-execution, intent-ci-done-endpoint-readiness, intent-done-retained-workspace, -agent-recovery and -capture-fallback backend specs.

Next proof action: none needed for this promise.
Prior disposition: matches CI repair d354fbc6, which moved these preconditions into the Review repository; the probe confirms the relocation kept its catching power.

Commands (scratch checkout):
- env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run --silent test:dashboard:backend -- backend-tests/review/story-review-completed-gaps.spec.ts
- env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run --silent test:e2e -- e2e/intent/intent-story-completed-source.spec.ts e2e/intent/intent-done-retained-landing.spec.ts --workers=2

Setup and waiting problems: Node type stripping failed on parameter properties (switched to esbuild); scratch worktree removal needed `--force` for untracked node_modules; load 3.2–4.0; no lock waits.
Costs: backend gaps spec ~3.8 s baseline / 4.3 s faulted; e2e pair 11.1 s / 15.5 s / 9.9 s; total test wall clock ~57 s. Human effort: none. Agent effort: not separately measured. Invocation-to-report elapsed: 218745 ms (measured).
